subject: compiler:mwcc-gc-1.2.5
value:
A distinct and recognisable residual: a file-scope address taken into a long-lived local pointer is lowered by the target as `lis rT,SYM@ha; addi rHOME,rT,SYM@lo`, forming the pointer DIRECTLY into its callee-saved home, while our build lowers it as `lis rT,@ha; addi r0,rT,@lo; mr rHOME,r0`, routing the ADDR16_LO result through r0 and paying a home copy. SIGNATURE: fndiff --ops reports `ours-only: -1 mr` with the opcode streams otherwise aligned, one instruction LONG, and fnasm shows the extra copy sourced from r0 immediately after an ADDR16_LO addi. DIAGNOSTIC VALUE: r0 is the tell - MWCC uses r0 as its scratch for address materialisation, so an addi whose destination is r0 followed by a copy into a saved register means the allocator declined to fuse the address formation with the home assignment. This is an allocator decision downstream of relocation lowering, not a spelling choice.

MEASURED SOURCE-UNREACHABLE across four axes over two sessions and two functions: declaration-initializer form (REGRESSED), statement reorder (NEUTRAL), declaration ORDER relocation (REGRESSED on both), and dead-local identity substitution (no candidate carrier). CRITICAL NEGATIVE CONTROL: the decl-initializer form is NOT the discriminator - fn_80088714 already spells it exactly as the byte-matched site in get_player_pos does and still pays the copy. Do not try to make the source 'look like' the matched site.

V2 CORRECTIONS (both material; v1 is wrong on scope and its disposition is unsafe):

1. SCOPE. This is NOT a two-instance pmotion phenomenon. The image-wide census finds 24 instances across 17 TUs (population P), against 659 functions where both sides coalesce (R) and 28 where both sides pay the copy (Q). Crucially the inverse population S = 0: in 683 opportunities we NEVER coalesce where retail pays the copy, only ever the reverse, at a 3.5% failure rate. See the census record for the full 24-function roster and the four instances that sit in functions already >=98% fuzzy.

2. DISPOSITION - DO NOT AUTHOR A WEBFRANK RULE. v1 called this 'a well-formed WebFrank REGISTER_ONLY candidate' and recommended writing a rule to close both instances. That is UNSAFE and must not be acted on. Every one of the 24 instances is COUNT-ASYMMETRIC (ours exactly one instruction longer than target), and per claim.law.webfrank-cannot-close-a-count-asymmetric-residual.20260831.v1 a count-asymmetric residual is STRUCTURAL in WebFrank's terms however register-flavoured it looks: it fails both the recolor-size precondition and the permutation-bijection precondition, and regnorm.py independently refuses the REGISTER_ONLY label on these functions. The residual_class in v1's own framing should be read as STRUCTURAL, not REGISTER_ONLY.

3. THE DISCRIMINANT IS MEASURED ABSENT, NOT MERELY UNKNOWN. Twelve candidate discriminants were measured across the full census and all twelve fail to separate P from R: symbol section/size/alignment (15 of 16 P symbols also appear in R - the SAME global takes both shapes), prologue-shadow scheduling flags (histograms near-identical, both capping at 4 hoisted), compiler build (identical L+1 outcome under both GC/1.2.5n and GC/1.2.5), -inline and exceptions flags, save style, leaf-ness, home-register identity, formation earliness, register pressure at the formation point, home-formation multiplicity, formation adjacency, and home-register web multiplicity. The last of these IS a strong discriminant for Q (mean 3.00 home definitions vs 1.68 in R - genuine coalescing interference, which is why retail pays the copy there too), which serves as the positive control proving the census can detect a real discriminant in this variable space. P's null is therefore a genuine null. Within-TU, within-symbol, same-cflags, same-compiler, same-spelling controls exist for most of P and the divergence is invisible in all of them; the purest case, pmotion::fn_80088714, is byte-identical to target through 0x34 and then differs solely in the addi's destination register, with the home register provably free. The variable is MWCC's internal coalescing worklist order, which is not a function of anything observable in the emitted stream.

3b. SPECIFICITY. The mechanism is confined to ADDR16_LO address materialisation. Of 31 functions paying surplus r0->callee-saved homings, 26 have an ADDR16_LO addi as the r0 producer and the rest are measurement artifacts; the five 'related extra-address-copy' parks (LoadItems, StartWorldLoad, init_player_change, pbDrawVerts, ProcessCritterList) carry ZERO such homings on either side and are a DIFFERENT mechanism that this law does not cover.

4. HANDLING. Screen for this signature, name it, and MOVE ON: treat a P-class `mr` as a known one-instruction residual and finish the surrounding body on its own merits. Add no new source axis to any P-class function without a positive control demonstrating direct-form lowering from a genuinely new mechanism. A Q-class copy (home register carrying multiple webs) is CORRECT output and must never be probed at all.
